text:
Elena (PM): Quick sync request — we need to lock scope for v2 route cutover that touches tool-calling + structured outputs. Customer-driven asks are changing the plan; want alignment by EOD. Two immediate risks: pricing delta on embeddings route and incompatible function-call contract.

Marco (Eng): On it. Can you paste the customer cases?

Elena (PM): Priya summarized in email. TL;DR: (1) function call arg names changed between v1/v2 -> breaks their tool parsers, (2) embedding dim mismatch (they expect 1536, v2 default is 1024), (3) they need token-preservation in function args for telemetry.

Priya (Customer Success): Confirmed. Customer A will pause migration until we promise a rollback plan or compat shim. They want explicit migration steps and a script.

Jun (Product): Proposal: implement a v1-compat shim for tool-calls for enterprise customers for 6 months. Expose opt-in header `x-rwd-compat: v1` and keep v1 route behavior unchanged for those calls. Start 90-day deprecation notice after GA. Thoughts?

Saira (Platform): Header-based routing is doable. We'll need special-cased caching and KV invalidation for shimmed requests. Expect infra cost + cache miss overhead estimate ~7%. Also need to lock routing policy for Dedicated.

Marco (Eng): Implementation sketch: router checks `x-rwd-compat`, forwards to compatibility adapter which rewrites function arg names and preserves token offsets in metadata. Add contract tests in the harness. SDKs need a small API to set the header.

Elena (PM): Launch criteria (draft): 1) Contract tests for function args pass against customer testcases; 2) Perf delta <15% 99p latency for shim vs native; 3) Migration docs + sample scripts published; 4) Canary route with traffic shaping + auto-fallback.

Priya (Customer Success): :thumbsup: Customers will want a migration guide + sample curl/python snippets and a rollback playbook. I'll collect the exact acceptance tests from Customer A and share.

Marco (Eng): Example header snippet for SDKs and curl:
```
# curl
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "x-rwd-compat: v1" \\n  -d '{"input":"...","tools":[...]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/chat
```
SDKs need a `compat: 'v1'` option.

Saira (Platform): One more infra note — we must preserve per-route quota accounting. Shimmed traffic should count against the same usage tier as v2 to avoid billing surprises. Finance signoff needed.

Elena (PM): Owners: Marco -> adapter + tests, Saira -> routing + billing integration, Jun -> docs + comms with Priya, Priya -> customer acceptance tests. ETA: Marco suggests 2 sprints for adapter+tests, 1 sprint for canary/config. Can we ship in 3 sprints?

Marco (Eng): Sounds right. I'll open the tracking epic and PR template.

Priya (Customer Success): Legal asked to review deprecation language and timelines before we publish.

Elena (PM): Ok. Plan: schedule canary next Wed, draft customer comms today, and freeze scope to only: header-based shim, arg-name adapter, and migration docs. No embedding-dim auto-resizing in first cut.

Marco (Eng): Noted — embedding dims out-of-scope for this immediate shim. We'll propose an embeddings compatibility feature separately.

Elena (PM): Any blockers?

Priya (Customer Success): None besides Legal signoff.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary router config targeted for 2024-07-03T14:00Z

Elena (PM): Great — I'll create the epic and assign. /remind @here to review the PRs when they land.
